name: money-truths
description: Money Truths — your own private money ledger for Claude and ChatGPT (Cloudflare Worker + D1 + MCP)

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: Your private ledger database (Cloudflare D1). Created for you; only your copy can read it.

SETUP_CODE.description: A passphrase you choose (at least 8 characters) — **write it down**. You'll type it once on your new ledger's `/setup` page, and again only if you ever need new links.
